summary: V2.2 clean candidate f64c6bb6b638e0ee74808572e976875c94efc2b3 can suppress the primary repair slot of an existing NEEDS_CHANGES lane at HARD completion pressure. _slot_flags marks the slot completion because NEEDS_CHANGES is a completion state, but also marks every primary as creation; ready_slots then drops any HARD-pressure creation slot before completion scoring. This can prevent an implementer from fixing an already-open PR and self-deadlock the completion queue.
evidence: tools/swarm/swarmctl_hardening.py: _slot_flags sets creation = slot_id == 'primary' while completion is true for lane state NEEDS_CHANGES.
tools/swarm/swarmctl_hardening.py: HARD branch continues when creation is true and lane is not override/completion-queue, regardless of completion=true.
tools/swarm/test_swarmctl_v22.py covers suppressing a NEW/READY primary but has no HARD-pressure NEEDS_CHANGES primary regression.

metadata.suggestedRegression: At HARD pressure, a normal product lane in NEEDS_CHANGES with its primary slot available remains runnable and is completion-boosted; only fresh READY primary creation is suppressed.
